product.name: Orbit
product.summary: Orbit is a local-first desktop app for modeling, visualizing, and comparing what a software product does.

entities.name: Contract Authoring
entities.summary: Open, create, edit and safely save a product contract file.

entities.name: Open and Create Contracts
entities.summary: Open an existing contract JSON or create a new valid one, with recent files and a no-file empty state.

entities.name: Validation and Diagnostics
entities.summary: Surface structural and semantic problems with actionable, located diagnostics and never auto-repair.

entities.name: Raw JSON Editing
entities.summary: Edit the contract as raw JSON with live validation; invalid text is never applied.

entities.name: Safe Saving and Conflict Protection
entities.summary: Save atomically to the selected file only and never silently overwrite external changes.

entities.name: Undoable Editing
entities.summary: All edits are in-memory and undoable until saved, with a modified indicator.

entities.name: Product Modeling
entities.summary: Describe what a product does as entities, behaviors, relationships, tests and evidence.

entities.name: Capabilities and Systems
entities.summary: Create, edit, reparent and delete capabilities and internal systems in same-kind hierarchies.

entities.name: Behavior Contracts
entities.summary: Define stable, identifiable behavior guarantees owned by exactly one entity.

entities.name: Typed Relationships
entities.summary: Model directed dependsOn, uses and implementedBy edges between entities.

entities.name: Tests and Evidence Records
entities.summary: Define test references, map them to behaviors, and record externally produced evidence.

entities.name: Product and Engineering Exploration
entities.summary: Navigate the capability and system models to understand what exists and how it fits together.

entities.name: Hierarchy Navigation and Search
entities.summary: Searchable, keyboard-navigable trees for capabilities (Product) and systems (Engineering).

entities.name: Entity Detail
entities.summary: Show summary, behaviors, mapped tests, relationships and evidence for the selected entity.

entities.name: Focused Relationship Graph
entities.summary: One-hop labeled, directed graph of an entity with an accessible textual alternative.

entities.name: Verification Assurance
entities.summary: Show how well behaviors are backed by tests and evidence, conservatively and by commit.

entities.name: Assurance Rollups
entities.summary: Count each behavior once across an entity subtree and classify test and evidence gaps.

entities.name: Evidence Freshness by Commit
entities.summary: Classify evidence as current, potentially outdated or unknown for a chosen inspected commit.

entities.name: Tests and Evidence Library
entities.summary: Browse and manage test definitions and evidence history independent of the tree.

entities.name: Change Comparison and Impact
entities.summary: Compare contract revisions semantically and infer potential downstream impact.

entities.name: Git Revision Comparison
entities.summary: Choose base and target from branches, commits, HEAD or working tree, read-only, with graceful non-Git use.

entities.name: Semantic Diff
entities.summary: ID-based field-level changes that ignore formatting and ordering and separate guarantees from verification metadata.

entities.name: Potential Impact Analysis
entities.summary: Traverse reverse relationship edges transitively to list potentially affected dependents with paths.

entities.name: In-Tree Change Highlighting
entities.summary: Mark added, modified, removed (ghost) and potentially affected entities in the Product and Engineering trees.

entities.name: Impact Workspace
entities.summary: Dedicated view with change totals, categorized change list, before/after details and impact chains.

entities.name: AI Agent Access
entities.summary: Let external AI agents do everything a user can in the running app, under the same safeguards.

entities.name: Secure Local Connection
entities.summary: Opt-in, localhost-only MCP endpoint with token management, client setup snippets and a stdio bridge.

entities.name: Agent Querying
entities.summary: Read-only tools to inspect status, contract, entities, assurance, tests, evidence, diagnostics and refs.

entities.name: Agent Editing
entities.summary: Validated, dry-runnable, undoable edits including atomic multi-operation batches and guarded saves.

entities.name: Live Visibility and Navigation
entities.summary: Agent actions show as toasts and an activity log, and agents can steer the user's view and comparison.

entities.name: Contract Interoperability
entities.summary: Keep the contract usable by external tools and agents without Orbit's GUI.

entities.name: Public Schema and CLI Validation
entities.summary: Ship a JSON Schema and a validate command with human and machine-readable diagnostics.

entities.name: External Evidence Production
entities.summary: Convert external test reports into evidence records without Orbit running tests.
